skin.dry.name: Dry
skin.dry.desc: Tight, flaky or rough; little visible oil. Craves hydration + barrier support.
skin.oily.name: Oily
skin.oily.desc: Shiny by midday, enlarged pores, prone to congestion. Likes lightweight, balancing care.
skin.combination.name: Combination
skin.combination.desc: Oily T-zone, normal-to-dry cheeks. Needs zone-aware, balanced layering.
skin.sensitive.name: Sensitive
skin.sensitive.desc: Reacts, stings or flushes easily. Prioritises soothing, fragrance-free, minimal actives.
skin.normal.name: Normal
skin.normal.desc: Balanced, few concerns. A simple maintenance routine keeps it glowing.
concern.acne.name: Acne & breakouts
concern.acne.desc: Clogged pores, blemishes and post-acne marks.
concern.acne.tip: Treat gently — over-stripping makes oil & breakouts worse. Patch-test new actives.
concern.aging.name: Anti-ageing & firmness
concern.aging.desc: Fine lines, loss of bounce and firmness.
concern.aging.tip: Sunscreen every morning does more for ageing than any serum.
concern.pigmentation.name: Dark spots & tone
concern.pigmentation.desc: Hyperpigmentation, melasma, uneven tone, post-acne marks.
concern.pigmentation.tip: Brightening actives only work paired with diligent SPF — UV undoes the progress.
concern.redness.name: Redness & sensitivity
concern.redness.tip: Repair the barrier first; add actives slowly, one at a time.
concern.pores.name: Pores & texture
concern.pores.desc: Visible pores, rough or bumpy texture.
concern.pores.tip: BHA dissolves oil inside pores; niacinamide helps refine the look over weeks.
concern.dryness.name: Dryness & dehydration
concern.dryness.tip: Layer a humectant on damp skin, then seal with a cream — the “7-skin” idea.
concern.dullness.name: Dullness & glow
concern.dullness.tip: Gentle exfoliation + vitamin C + hydration = the “glass skin” glow.
concern.oiliness.name: Oil control
concern.oiliness.tip: Don’t fight oil with harsh products — balance and lightweight hydration work better.
routine.oilcleanse.name: Oil cleanser / balm
routine.oilcleanse.desc: First half of the double cleanse — melts sunscreen, makeup and sebum.
routine.oilcleanse.layering: On dry hands & dry face, then emulsify with water.
routine.watercleanse.name: Water-based cleanser
routine.watercleanse.desc: Gentle low-pH cleanser removes the rest without stripping the barrier.
routine.exfoliate.name: Exfoliant
routine.exfoliate.desc: Chemical exfoliant (AHA/BHA/PHA) clears dead cells & unclogs pores.
routine.exfoliate.layering: 1–3× per week, PM only. Never with retinol the same night.
routine.toner.name: Toner / skin
routine.toner.desc: Hydrating toner rebalances and preps skin to absorb the next steps.
routine.toner.layering: Pat in with hands; layer 2–3× for the “7-skin” method.
routine.essence.name: Essence
routine.essence.desc: Lightweight ferment/hydration layer — the heart of K-beauty glow.
routine.treatment.name: Serum / ampoule
routine.treatment.desc: Your targeted active for your concern (brightening, firming, calming).
routine.treatment.layering: AM: antioxidants (vit C). PM: retinol/exfoliating actives.
routine.mask.name: Sheet mask
routine.mask.layering: 10–20 min; pat in the leftover essence.
routine.eye.name: Eye cream
routine.eye.desc: Lighter formula for the delicate eye area; hydration & peptides.
routine.moisturizer.name: Moisturizer
routine.moisturizer.desc: Locks in everything; ceramides & humectants seal the barrier.
routine.moisturizer.layering: Thinnest → thickest rule ends here (before SPF).
routine.sunscreen.name: Sunscreen (SPF)
routine.sunscreen.desc: The single most important anti-ageing step. Every morning, rain or shine.
routine.sunscreen.layering: Last AM step; ~2 finger-lengths; reapply midday.
routine.sleeping.name: Sleeping mask / occlusive
routine.sleeping.desc: Optional final PM seal (“slugging”) for extra overnight repair.
routine.sleeping.layering: Thin layer as the very last PM step.
ing.snail.name: Snail Mucin
ing.snail.explainer: Snail secretion filtrate is a K-beauty icon — a glossy hydrator famed for that plump, dewy finish.
ing.snail.benefit.0: Hydrates & helps support a smoother, bouncier skin feel
ing.centella.name: Centella (Cica)
ing.centella.explainer: “Cica” = Centella asiatica (tiger grass). The go-to soother for sensitive, stressed or breakout-prone skin.
ing.niacinamide.name: Niacinamide (B3)
ing.niacinamide.explainer: The ultimate multitasker — 2–5% suits most skin. The old “don’t mix with vitamin C” rule is a debunked myth.
ing.niacinamide.benefit.0: Helps refine the look of pores & even tone
ing.hyaluronic.name: Hyaluronic Acid
ing.hyaluronic.explainer: A humectant magnet for moisture. Apply to damp skin and seal with cream so it pulls water IN, not out.
ing.hyaluronic.benefit.0: Draws water into skin for instant plumping
ing.ceramide.name: Ceramides
ing.ceramide.explainer: The skin barrier’s own lipids. Essential for dry, sensitive, or over-exfoliated skin.
ing.ceramide.benefit.0: Rebuilds the skin’s “mortar” to lock in moisture
ing.panthenol.name: Panthenol (Pro-B5)
ing.panthenol.explainer: A gentle, universally tolerated soother — great in barrier-repair and post-active routines.
ing.panthenol.benefit.0: Soothes & helps support healing of stressed skin
ing.propolis.name: Propolis
ing.propolis.explainer: Bee-derived honey-like extract; a glow-giving favourite (skip if you have a bee-product allergy).
ing.mugwort.name: Mugwort (Artemisia)
ing.mugwort.explainer: A traditional Korean botanical (“ssuk”) prized for soothing sensitive, troubled skin.
ing.heartleaf.name: Heartleaf (Houttuynia)
ing.heartleaf.explainer: Houttuynia cordata — a trending calming extract for oily, breakout-prone skin.
ing.rice.name: Rice Extract
ing.rice.explainer: A heritage Korean ingredient for that soft, luminous “mochi skin” finish.
ing.ginseng.name: Ginseng
ing.ginseng.explainer: A premium hanbang (Korean herbal) hero, central to luxury anti-ageing lines.
ing.greentea.name: Green Tea
ing.greentea.explainer: Camellia sinensis from Jeju — antioxidant-rich and beloved for oily, sensitive skin.
ing.galactomyces.name: Galactomyces Ferment
ing.galactomyces.explainer: A fermented essence star (think “first essence”) for radiance and refined texture.
ing.pdrn.name: PDRN (Salmon DNA)
ing.pdrn.explainer: Polydeoxyribonucleotide — the 2026 “salmon DNA” buzz active. Note: topical evidence is emerging; benefits are cosmetic, not the same as clinical injectables.
ing.peptides.name: Peptides
ing.peptides.explainer: Amino-acid chains that signal skin to look firmer — a gentle anti-ageing route, even for sensitive skin.
ing.vitaminc.name: Vitamin C
ing.vitaminc.explainer: Best in the AM under sunscreen. Pure L-ascorbic acid is potent; derivatives are gentler for sensitive skin.
ing.retinol.name: Retinol
ing.retinol.explainer: PM only, start low & slow (1–2×/week), always SPF next day. Avoid during pregnancy.
ing.retinol.benefit.0: Gold-standard for lines & texture over time
ing.bakuchiol.name: Bakuchiol
ing.bakuchiol.explainer: A gentler, often better-tolerated alternative to retinol — but data on pregnancy safety is limited.
ing.aha.name: AHA (Glycolic/Lactic)
ing.aha.explainer: Water-loving acids that resurface the top layer. Lactic is gentler; glycolic is stronger. SPF a must.
ing.aha.benefit.0: Surface exfoliation for glow & even tone
ing.bha.name: BHA (Salicylic)
ing.bha.explainer: Salicylic acid dives into oily pores to decongest. Ideal for blackheads & breakouts.
ing.pha.name: PHA (Gluconolactone)
ing.pha.explainer: Large-molecule acid that exfoliates very gently — great for sensitive skin new to acids.
ing.azelaic.name: Azelaic Acid
ing.azelaic.explainer: A multitasker beloved for redness, bumps and post-acne marks — usually well tolerated.
ing.tranexamic.name: Tranexamic Acid
ing.tranexamic.explainer: A favourite for melasma and stubborn pigmentation, often paired with niacinamide.
ing.arbutin.name: Alpha-Arbutin
ing.arbutin.explainer: A gentle, stable brightener — a softer route to fading dark spots.
ing.madecassoside.name: Madecassoside
ing.madecassoside.explainer: The most studied active in cica — concentrated soothing & barrier support.
ing.madecassoside.benefit.0: The purified calming hero from centella
ing.betaglucan.name: Beta-Glucan
ing.betaglucan.explainer: A soothing humectant that hydrates and calms — gentle enough for the most reactive skin.
ing.squalane.name: Squalane
ing.squalane.explainer: A skin-mimicking emollient (usually plant-derived) that softens without heaviness.
gloss.0.def: A watery first hydration step that rebalances skin and preps it to absorb the next layers. K-beauty toners hydrate (they don’t “strip”).
gloss.1.def: A lightweight, watery hydrator — often fermented — that is the signature heart of a K-beauty routine, layered between toner and serum.
gloss.2.def: Concentrated treatment for a specific concern. An “ampoule” is typically a more potent serum.
gloss.3.def: A light, milky moisturizer — common in Korean routines for those who find creams too heavy.
gloss.4.def: Cleansing twice at night: an oil cleanser to melt SPF/makeup, then a water cleanser to wash away the rest.
gloss.5.def: The goal look: poreless-appearing, luminous, ultra-hydrated, “see-through” clarity.
gloss.6.def: Sealing the routine with a thin occlusive (e.g. petrolatum) overnight to lock in moisture — best for dry skin.
gloss.7.def: Rotating active nights (exfoliate → retinoid → recover → recover) to get results with less irritation.
gloss.8.def: The skin’s outer protective layer of cells & lipids. Healthy barrier = calm, hydrated, resilient skin.
gloss.9.def: Layering a hydrating toner up to seven times to deeply plump the skin — adjust the count to your skin.
gloss.10.def: A serum-soaked fabric mask for a quick hydration or soothing boost.
gloss.11.def: A Korean invention: liquid foundation/SPF in a sponge compact for dewy, buildable, on-the-go coverage.
gloss.12.def: Filters that absorb UV. Lightweight, no white cast — Korean formulas are famous for elegant textures.
gloss.13.def: Zinc oxide / titanium dioxide that sit on skin and deflect UV. Best for very sensitive skin (can leave a slight cast).
gloss.14.def: The Asian measure of UVA (ageing-ray) protection. PA++++ is the highest — look for it alongside SPF.
gloss.15.def: Traditional Korean herbal medicine ingredients (ginseng, etc.) used in heritage & luxury skincare.
gloss.16.def: Fermented ingredients (galactomyces, bifida) broken into smaller, skin-friendly molecules prized for glow.
trend.pdrn.title: PDRN “Salmon DNA”
trend.pdrn.blurb: The breakout firming active of 2026 — in serums, creams & pads.
trend.barrier.title: Barrier-first skincare
trend.barrier.blurb: Less is more: repair the barrier before piling on actives.
trend.microbiome.title: Microbiome & postbiotics
trend.microbiome.blurb: Ferment & probiotic care to support skin’s natural balance.
trend.exosome.title: Exosomes & next-gen
trend.exosome.blurb: Lab-advanced regenerative claims move from clinics into cosmetics.
trend.heartleaf.title: Heartleaf everything
trend.heartleaf.blurb: Houttuynia (어성초) is the calming hero for oily, troubled skin.
trend.mens.title: Men’s K-beauty boom
trend.mens.blurb: Korea leads the world in men’s skincare — simple, effective routines.
trend.suncare.title: Sun-stick & reapply
trend.suncare.blurb: Sticks & cushions make midday SPF reapplication effortless.
trend.skinimalism.title: Skinimalism
trend.skinimalism.blurb: Curated 4–5 step routines beat the maximalist 10-step for many.

mens.title: Men’s simple routine
mens.desc: Korea leads the world in men’s skincare. You don’t need 10 steps — start with four.
mens.step.0.name: Gentle cleanser
mens.step.1.name: Hydrating toner/essence
mens.step.2.name: Moisturizer
mens.step.3.name: Sunscreen
mens.step.3.note: Every morning — the easiest anti-ageing win.
